dedupe_keys.name: worlddab country status of digital radio dab services

description: The WorldDAB countries page groups nations by the status of Digital Audio Broadcasting: countries with regular services, countries with trials or regulation, and countries with interest. Contents: the regular-service list includes Australia, Austria, Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Saudi Arabia, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Türkiye, Ukraine and the United Kingdom among others; the trial and regulation list includes Algeria, Egypt, Ghana, Indonesia, Ireland, Kenya, Malaysia, New Zealand, South Africa, Thailand and the United Arab Emirates among others. Each country link leads to information on regulatory frameworks, DAB network coverage, services on air, receivers, the automotive sector, trials and marketing. WorldDAB also offers an infographic on DAB status across key markets. Producer: WorldDAB, the industry body promoting digital radio. Coverage: global, by country. Access: public web pages, no bulk data file. Licence and cost: free to read; no reuse licence is stated. Caveats: the content is qualitative and industry-authored, the classification date is not given on the page read, and per-country pages were not read. Simulation uses: it identifies where digital radio networks exist for broadcasting resilience, emergency-alert channel and coverage planning studies. Related record: German broadcast transmitter data (data-bnetza-broadcast-transmitter-data-gbg).
